name: home-zh
description: Example rule pack for a household / smart-home assistant. Opt-in only: nothing here is used unless MEMORY_RULE_PATTERNS=home-zh. Copy this file as a starting point for your own domain.

rules.name: noise_quiet
rules.regex: [^。！？；\n]{0,12}(?:保持安静|安静一点|安静些|安静|静音|小声|别吵|不要吵|太吵)

rules.name: light_dim
rules.regex: [^。！？；\n]{0,8}(?:灯光|光线|照明|灯)[^。！？；\n]{0,8}(?:调暗|暗一点|暗些|柔和|不要太亮|别太亮|刺眼|太亮|太强)
